policy: Each decision is about the whole claim statement, not a shared source URL. A non-null fact names an existing must_verify statement with the same factual content. Null retains the original source and requires passage verification, including when a claim combines a plan fact with additional substantive details. Explanatory limits that repeat the existing caveats are not new historical facts. This map does not confer PLAN, CONFIRMED or any verifier verdict.
